skill.name: webask-webhook-setup
skill.description: Настраивает отправку ответов опроса WebAsk на внешний адрес вебхуком: адрес, метод, состав полей и их имена, заголовки, отправка незавершённых. Применяется, когда человек просит слать ответы на свой сервер, в свою систему, в Make или n8n, поменять поля вебхука или включить и выключить его.
skill.summary: Configure WebAsk webhooks, map survey fields, and check delivery through WebAsk MCP tools.
skill.author: webaskio

content.user_title: Connect WebAsk Surveys to Your Webhook
content.value_statement: Survey responses can fail to reach your systems when webhook destinations, field names, or authentication are incorrect. This skill guides WebAsk webhook configuration and checks delivery logs through MCP tools.
actual_capabilities: Check workspace webhook availability and inspect existing survey webhooks before creating another.
Configure an HTTPS destination, HTTP method, selected response fields, field names, and receiver authentication headers.
Read survey structure to identify question names and identifiers for field mapping.
Configure incomplete response delivery with a delay of 1, 6, 12, or 24 hours when requested.
Inspect delivery logs and distinguish successful responses, receiver errors, and an empty delivery history.
Update or toggle webhooks, and delete them only upon an explicit request.
limitations: Requires access to the declared WebAsk MCP tools and a workspace plan that supports webhooks.
Does not build or host the receiving endpoint, or repair failures inside external systems.
Cannot recover masked authentication headers; updates replace the entire webhook configuration.
Delivery cannot be verified from empty logs, and delayed incomplete responses do not guarantee duplicate prevention.

use_cases.title: Route selected survey responses to a CRM
use_cases.description: Send phone numbers and relevant answers to a CRM endpoint with field names that match its requirements.

use_cases.title: Connect survey responses to automation workflows
use_cases.description: Configure a WebAsk webhook for a Make or n8n receiver and decide whether incomplete responses should be included.

use_cases.title: Diagnose webhook delivery failures
use_cases.description: Inspect response codes, check configuration, and avoid resending deliveries while the receiver continues to fail.

prompt_templates.title: Check webhook readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether my WebAsk workspace supports webhooks and list existing webhooks for [survey]. Do not change any settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect availability and current configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Create a survey webhook
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure a webhook for [survey] to [HTTPS endpoint] using POST. Send only [selected questions] with these destination field names: [mapping]. Check for duplicates first and keep incomplete responses disabled.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: connect selected survey answers to a receiver.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate failed deliveries
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect webhook logs for [survey] and explain recent delivery failures. Check the destination, method, and field mapping. Do not resend records while the receiver still returns errors.

prompt_templates.title: Update an existing integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Update [webhook] for [survey] to use [new HTTPS endpoint] and [field mapping]. Include incomplete responses after 12 hours and preserve its current enabled state. Account for full configuration replacement and masked headers without requesting secrets in chat.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: change routing and incomplete response settings while preserving authentication.

output_examples.input: Check readiness before connecting my survey to a webhook.
output: Example readiness result: The workspace supports webhooks.
An existing webhook already targets the requested address.
No settings were changed. Confirm whether to update the existing webhook.

output_examples.input: Check delivery after configuring selected survey fields.
output: Example delivery result: POST is configured for the approved HTTPS receiver.
Selected fields are mapped to phone and rating; incomplete responses remain disabled.
The latest delivery returned HTTP 200, indicating receiver acceptance.

output_examples.input: Explain why webhook deliveries are failing.
output: Example diagnosis: The latest delivery returned HTTP 401.
Receiver authentication needs checking; masked header values cannot be recovered from the current configuration.
No records were resent. Enter credentials in the WebAsk dashboard before another delivery check.

best_practices: Confirm the destination and inspect existing webhooks before creating one; send only the fields the receiving system needs.
Enter receiver credentials in the WebAsk dashboard and account for masked headers before replacing a webhook configuration.
Check delivery logs after setup and address receiver errors before resending records.
anti_patterns: Creating duplicate webhooks or enabling a webhook that someone intentionally disabled without confirmation.
Requesting access keys in chat or replacing masked authentication headers with empty values.
Resending deliveries while the receiver still returns errors or deleting a webhook without an explicit request.

faq.question: What does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires access to the declared WebAsk MCP tools, a survey, and a workspace plan that supports webhooks.

faq.question: Can it connect WebAsk to Make or n8n?
faq.answer: Yes, when your workflow provides an HTTPS receiver. You must supply its expected HTTP method, fields, and authentication requirements.

faq.question: Can I rename survey fields for my receiving system?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill reads survey structure and uses webhook field mapping to match the names expected by your receiver.

faq.question: Can it send incomplete survey responses?
faq.answer: Yes, when requested, with a delay of 1, 6, 12, or 24 hours. Completed responses are the default.

faq.question: Should I paste authentication keys into chat?
faq.answer: No. Enter them in webhook headers through the WebAsk dashboard. Existing header values are masked and cannot be recovered for updates.

faq.question: Does an empty delivery log mean the webhook is broken?
faq.answer: No. It can mean no responses have been delivered yet. The skill cannot confirm successful delivery until a log entry exists.
